name: Plain O20 3R at the lead's seats, no knuckle or drive, with a one-sided arm-arc relay doing K's job (the relay's simplicity column)
verdict: DEAD (pre-registered kill above 17.5): frozen exact Bench(110,360) 26.42 (near-touch 27.53, chain-only in-band reading 30.6) vs the lead's 18.28 and champion 75.94; fast Bench(60,160) best 18.45 (near-touch 19.55; plain best 16.64) vs the lead's fast 12.50. The relay KINEMATICS are worth the lead's K and more (ideal relay, no hardware: 3.53 fast / 10.22 frozen exact at PHI 75, psi2 -14), but an arm-fixed circular arc long enough to do K's job (PHI 45-75) wraps onto the medial arm and meets the TORSO at phi = 0 (across the body, plane 135-150, and arm-at-side axial rotation: track up to -10.1 mm into the chest); the converged optimum therefore keeps PHI ~19 where the relay does little (ideal at that arc 17.27 fast) and pays the knee stack's 5.4-5.9 mm lift onto the carriage. 4 counted joints, complexity 29.0 vs the lead's 18.5.
limiter: the arm-fixed relay arc's length vs the torso: at the only low-lift axis family (tilt ~12 toward taz ~237, lift 5.4-5.9 mm) the arc must turn toward the medial arm (sgn -1 is kinematically wrong: ideal PHI 60 sgn -1 44.31 fast), and at PHI 45 (arc 70 deg, 93 mm) 9 of 14 fast contacts are the un-relayed track in the chest (plane 135-150 elev 15-75 axial -45..-60: -0.5 to -10.1 mm, 7 of 8 below -7; arm at side axial 60-120: -5.6 mm); PHI 19 avoids the torso but leaves 103/360 fold losses frozen; lift costs the chain 0.04-0.07 in-band (chain-only 0.847-0.865)
note: Convergence gate (near-touch objective, 387 relay-hardware configurations on Bench(60,160) fast, local ES + axis scan; farm closed): gain over the second half 0.425 pts, over the last third 0.425 pts, top-5 spread 0.193 pts -> PASSED (plain gap: 1.058 / 1.058 / 0.451). Kit reproduction of nok_metal exact (+30 54/10/1/44, +45 68/15/1/53, +60 83/15/1/68 relayed/collide/contact/clean) but the kit's q 1.0 metal parks hub 2 171 mm from GH, so the score comes from the lead's own model with K welded (smhi 5 + |dK| <= 0.1 gate), drive metal deleted, hub K + link 1a/1b kept as metal (first pass), relay solve / metal / lift / jams from armarc-relay-knuckle-4r. The folded-side hub-1 collisions of the kit become 1-4 'parts' poses in the lead's metal. Window shift psi2 (J2 rest axis about J1) alone: welded 3R control 39.80 -> 28.87-31.83 fast at psi2 -9 (a2 61.8-62.1). Frozen wear is of the es3 best (k 197), the converged best (k 381) is within 1.1 fast points of it. Continuity flood not run (dead before it matters: the flood can only drop relayed poses).

mechanism.notes: J1, J2, J3 O20 v5 stacks on MR117 pairs (3 counted) + the relay (COUNTED 4th R: carriage in a slotted circular Ti shell about a GH-through arm-fixed axis, iglidur strip = 1 sliding pair, constant-force spring onto a zero dowel = 1 spring, end dowel at PHI); bodies link 1 (one bent bar), link 2, member 3, carriage; made: base adapter, link 1, link 2, member 3 / E strap, 3 hub shafts, track shell, carriage, pad mount; bought: 3 MR117 pairs, J3 stop dowel, 2 relay dowels, constant-force spring, iglidur strip (counted as 11); hub K, bell crank, nose, horn deleted against the lead; cuff knee as the lead

audit.bar: lead 18.28 frozen exact Bench(110,360) (stated by hand; the template's 68.93 / 75.94 / 30.35 defaults are stale); pre-registered kill 17.5
audit.v_source: v_* are the author's frozen exact Bench(110,360) per-pose dump (docs/research/fold_ceiling/kfree_armarc_frozen_exact.json) re-tallied by the auditor: CB.gap_of reproduces 26.42, why_ws 242 / fold 103 / contact 9 / j3stop 4 / parts 2. Not re-run (the exact wear takes 2337 s, over the 25-min audit box).
audit.fast_repro: k 381 re-run: 18.45 / near-touch 19.55, reach 0.7375, ib14 0.9027, contact 0.022 - identical to the sweep
audit.gate: re-computed from the sweep: near-touch 0.425 / 0.425 / 0.193 pts (PASSED); plain 1.058 / 1.058 / 0.451. Independent audit ES (74 configs, near-touch, (1+1)-ES from k 381 + 5 wide probes; docs/research/fold_ceiling/kfree_armarc_audit_es.json): near-touch best unchanged 19.55 (plain 17.81 at several neighbours, near-touch 20.08-21.25 there)
audit.perfect_metal_bound: at the frozen config the 107 kinematic losses (fold 103, J3 stop 4; every one has no welded solution in [0, PHI]) cap reach at 253/360 = 0.7028 even if every contact / parts pose became a take with zero contact and ib14 >= 0.90: gap >= 19.72 > 18.28 > 17.5. Hub K kept as metal (vs the morphology's one bent bar) therefore cannot rescue it.
audit.thin_region_probes: PHI 25 / 30 / 35 / 40 at psi2 -13 / -14 / -15 / -16 (axis tilt 12.05 / taz 236.92): fast 23.93 / 30.54 / 28.12 / 28.59 (near-touch 23.94 / 30.55 / 31.55 / 30.87); fold 35 / 30 / 24 / 22 vs contact 7 / 12 / 14 / 15: the longer arc trades fold for contact ~1:1, as the author's limiter says
audit.sense_minus: the sweep's 11 sgn -1 entries were all at psi2 0; ideal relay (no metal) sgn -1 PHI 60: psi2 -12 29.06 fast, best axis psi2 -8.92 21.39 fast (vs sgn +1 ideal 11.57 at PHI 45 / 9.25 at PHI 75): not a missed region (docs/research/fold_ceiling/kfree_armarc_audit_sgnm1.json)
audit.red_team: the optimum sits on a jam cliff: 25 of the 68 audit-ES samples (steps of ~0.3-2 deg in PHI / tilt / taz / psi2 around k 381, e.g. taz 236.92 -> 235.3) carry 7-76 jams (E strap / knee on the arm-fixed track at phi 0) and score 34.6-132.1 fast. A 1-2 deg relay-axis build error turns the design into a jammer: a real build reads worse than the stated number, not better.
